API Documentation Uri:
https://linear.app/developers/graphql

Action
Create Comment
Creates a new comment.

Action
Create Issue
Creates a new issue.

Action
Delete Comment
Deletes an existing comment.

Action
Delete Issue
Deletes an existing issue.

Action
Execute GraphQL Query
Performs an arbitrary authorized GraphQL query.

Action
Get Comment
Retrieves an existing comment.

Action
Get Issue
Retrieves an existing issue.

Action
Update Comment
Updates an existing comment.

Action
List Comments
Retrieves a list of comments from account.

Action
List Issues
Retrieves a list of issues from account.

I am planning to build an integration component for linear. Could you provide me with a list and description of the most commonly used and essential API endpoints for this service? Specifically, I am interested in endpoints related to core operations. For each endpoint, please include the HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE), the endpoint URL or path, link to documentation, a brief description of its purpose, provide list of inputs. If possible, also mention any authentication requirements.
Create the service json as well, (serviceJson property)
ignore input parameters for pagination, it could be for example page, offset, limit, etc.

Action naming conventions: Try to avoid naming with "List", such as "List Users", "List Contacts" etc. Use "Find" instead. For example "Find Users", "FInd Contacts". These actions have usually input parameters for search, such as "query", "search" or similar.

Provide information about authentication, include type of authentication, and other properties. Provide information about authentication endpoint URL, token URL for managing access token - for obtaining access token and refreshing access token. Provide information about profile info URL, where is possible to get information about current user. It is used for getting user profile information, such as email, name, etc. (authentication property)
